procedure_name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY Golden Health Card
summary: Cashless secondary and tertiary hospitalization cover of up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year at empaneled hospitals.

steps.title: Check eligibility on portal
steps.description: Search name or ration card number on National Beneficiary portal (SECC list or state NFSA database).

steps.title: Aadhaar e-KYC authentication
steps.description: Perform face-authentication via mobile app or biometric scan at Ayushman Mitra hospital kiosk.

steps.title: Family member matching
steps.description: Verify relationships and link dependent family members.

steps.title: Instant Ayushman Card download
steps.description: Download official PVC Ayushman Bharat card with PM-JAY unique ID.

steps.title: Cashless hospital admission
steps.description: Show card at any empanelled public or private hospital for cashless treatment up to ₹5,00,000.
